summary_en: 200,000 shares (3.2% of S/O ex-treasury); ¥406M upper limit; ToSTNeT-3 method at ¥2,030/share (closing price 2026-08-06); settlement 2026-08-07; execution window single morning session; results published post-close.
title_en: Notice of acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-exchange transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 6 August 2026, WATANABE SATO CO., LTD. (TSE Standard: 1807) announced a single-block treasury share purchase via ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange transaction. The company will place a buy order at the market closing price of ¥2,030 per share on the morning of 7 August 2026 (8:45 AM session). The purchase targets up to 200,000 shares (3.2% of the 6,243,457 shares outstanding excluding treasury) for an upper limit of ¥406 million. The stated rationale is to strengthen shareholder returns, improve capital efficiency, and execute flexible capital policy in response to changing business environment. Results will be published after the trading session closes. The filing notes that execution may be partial or absent depending on market conditions and order matching.
